Independent rational checks compute the full sandwich and all randomization identities on all 256 binary potential-outcome pairs for N=4,n1=2 and six additional populations, including unequal arms, signed/rational outcomes, and constant effects; the table fractions and square-root rounding intervals also pass exact checks.
